source_ref.production_note: Live-action filmic brand spot, ~30s, 1920x1080 23.976fps. A24-style intimate domestic vignette montage joined by seamless morph/match transitions (no hard cuts — frame-diff flat), 2.39:1 letterboxed, shallow-DOF handheld push-ins, warm low-key grade. The wordless emotional montage is recontextualised by an on-screen typed ChatGPT prompt + the assistant's witty, emotionally-aware recipe response, then a continuous pull-back out through the apartment window to a brick exterior + ChatGPT logo end-card. Reference analysed for LSB craft dataset; on-screen copy preserved verbatim, cast abstracted, logo generic.

target_demo: 20-30s general consumers; people who cook/date/host; emotionally-driven AI-curious mainstream
narrative_arc: Wordless intimate vignettes (a woman savours food alone → an emotional dinner with a partner → playful cooking together) establish feeling first; a typed ChatGPT prompt ('a recipe that says, I like you, but want to play it cool') reframes the montage as the answer to one human question; ChatGPT's warm, witty recipe response scrolls as the camera pulls out through the window to the building exterior; resolve on the ChatGPT logo end-card. The product is positioned as an emotionally-intelligent collaborator in everyday human moments.
creative_device: Reframe device: a wordless emotional montage is retroactively revealed as the output of a single emotionally-nuanced ChatGPT prompt; the assistant's reply is written with human warmth/wit ('don't sweat it. You got this.'), and a continuous morph/pull-out construction makes the whole film feel like one breath. Product shown through feeling, not features.

production_signature.signature_note: Seamless morph/match transitions between vignettes (frame-diff flat — zero hard cuts across 720 frames; wardrobe/scene changes are the only tell). One long continuous pull-back from kitchen interior out through a window to the building exterior anchors the back half.
production_signature.color_grade_note: warm low-key tungsten-leaning grade, amber-lifted shadows, cool dusk split only in the exterior resolve

global_layout.layout_note: 2.39:1 letterbox throughout. Faces/figures centred in shallow DOF; ChatGPT text as clean centered-then-left white captions over the imagery; back half hands the frame to running response text over the brick exterior.

recurring_motifs: one warm window in a cool city

copywriting.tagline_structure: no spoken/branded tagline; the conceptual hook is the typed user prompt; brand sign-off is the wordmark only
copywriting.cta_text_structure: no explicit CTA; brand lockup ('ChatGPT') only, no URL/tagline
copywriting.copy_strategy: All copy is the on-screen typed ChatGPT exchange: an emotionally-nuanced user request answered by a recipe written like a thoughtful friend (acknowledges subtext, lowers stakes, ends on reassurance). Demonstrates the product's value (emotional intelligence) by showing the artifact rather than describing features.

lines.text: I need a recipe that says, "I like you, but want to play it cool."
Here's the move: Lemon-Garlic Butter Pasta with Cherry Tomatoes.
All in all, this should make for a chill, intimate Friday night that feels like you really tried just the right amount.
Above all, don't sweat it. You got this.

captions.text: It's fresh, colorful, and smells incredible. It says, "I care," without crossing into "I spent three days marinating something in saffron."

Why This Works — Plays it cool — Comforting and familiar. / Signals effort — From-scratch sauce. / Beginner-proof — Minimal steps, big results. / Flavor profile — Lemon + tomatoes + garlic = crowd-pleaser.

The Flow (Simple Version) — 1. Boil pasta water; salt it well. / 2. Cook tomatoes in olive oil until they just burst. / 3. Add garlic, lemon zest, lemon juice, butter, and chili flakes. / 4. Toss in pasta and splash of pasta water; stir until silky. / 5. Finish with fresh basil, parmesan, and black pepper.
Bonus Tips — Keep a towel handy for plating; plus, it looks pro. / If you want to add a protein, throw some quick pan-seared shrimp or chicken on top, but only if you're feeling confident.

copywriting.narration_note: No spoken VO (ASR found only faint low-confidence dialogue under music). The ad's copy is entirely the on-screen typed ChatGPT conversation, captured verbatim.

typography.color_strategy: plain white over imagery, no color boxes
typography.typo_motion_dominant: calm app-style type-on and upward scroll; reads like a chat assistant 'speaking' rather than kinetic ad typography

vfx.notable_vfx_note: Signature is invisibility: seamless morph/match transitions + one continuous interior-to-exterior pull-back. The only graphic 'vfx' is the calm ChatGPT text type-on/scroll and the end lockup.

audio.voice_vs_caption: No structured spoken narration: ASR found only a few faint diegetic words early on ("Good?"; "Yeah?"; "Very good.") under a music bed. The ad's actual COPY is the on-screen typed ChatGPT conversation (preserved verbatim in copywriting). Those faint words are low-confidence and may be soft inter-character dialogue or music.
audio.audio_note: faster-whisper base.en (int8) transcribed locally after fetching model.bin via HTTP range chunks (40MiB proxy cap bypass). Result: a music bed with only sparse, faint, low-confidence words — confirms there is no spoken VO; the copy is the on-screen ChatGPT text.

The human figure is an anonymous everyday woman, never a photographic likeness of any real individual, and there are no logos or graphics in frame; this is purely a held, breathing portrait of someone tasting something and quietly feeling it. Additional reconstruction detail: keep the anamorphic 2.39:1 letterbox bars at roughly 10–12 percent of frame height top and bottom, and treat them as a fixed mask; the woman's near eye must hold the only critical-focus plane, parked on the upper-right third intersection, while everything from her far cheek backward melts into bokeh. Stage the warm key as a single soft source at camera-right about 30 degrees off axis and a touch above eye-line so the catchlight sits high in the iris; let the unlit left cheek fall two-to-three stops down into amber-brown #2A1A10 rather than neutral black. The background practical reads as one amber globe orb at the upper-centre (#D4924A) and a cooler cream window smear at upper-left (#EDE8D0); both must stay fully defocused. Skin keeps natural pore micro-texture and a faint sheen on the lit cheekbone, hair shows individual warm-rimmed strands. The pale pasta bite entering low-frame at the end is soft, glossy, hand-held, lit by the same warm key. Camera energy is a stabilised handheld float with an almost-subliminal push-in of a few percent over the beat, no whip, no rack focus. analyst_notes: (1) ★전 프레임 판독: 720/720 프레임을 분할 에이전트(48프레임 단위, 체크포인트)로 빠짐없이 순차 판독. frame-diff 결과 하드컷 0건 — 영상 전체가 심리스 모핑/매치 구성. 컷 경계는 의상/장면 전환으로 수동 식별해 7컷(shot_count_corrected)으로 확정(scenedetect=1). (2) 핵심 카피=화면의 ChatGPT 타이핑 대화 전문(프롬프트+레시피 응답+'Bonus Tips'+사인오프)을 verbatim 보존. (3) 구조 핵심=무언의 감정 몽타주를 프롬프트 한 줄이 사후 재맥락화 → 응답이 스크롤되며 카메라가 창밖 브릭 외관으로 연속 풀아웃 → ChatGPT 로고 엔드카드. (4) 오디오: 초기엔 모델 다운로드가 40MiB에서 차단됐으나 model.bin을 HTTP range 청크로 우회 다운로드해 faster-whisper base.en 전사 성공. 결과=음악 베드 + 극히 faint한 저신뢰 대사 몇 마디('Good?/Yeah?/Very good.')뿐 → 구조적 VO 없음 확인. 카피는 화면 ChatGPT 텍스트가 본체(verbatim). transcribed_by=faster_whisper. (5) 추상화: 출연자=익명 일반인 유형으로 기술(실명/초상 복제 금지), ChatGPT 로고는 generic으로, 단 화면 카피·워드마크는 보존. (6) LSB 가치: '감정 먼저, 기능 안 보임 + 심리스 모핑 + 카피=화면대화' 공식은 cross-pollination 입력으로 강력(특히 우리은행/배민류 '기능 직설' 톤과 정반대 대비 신호).
